title: cyperus ovularis
intro: Cyperus ovularis, commonly known as Oval-Head Sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include relieving various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus ovularis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections and inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
